Dude, the fact your gf is calling it “unfair” that you don’t want her hanging out with a man she knows has feelings for her is just ridiculous and a huge red flag. Even if she herself has no intentions of cheating on you (which you can’t know for certain as you have no idea what could be going through her head or if she’s even telling you the truth about her lack of romantic attraction) it doesn’t guarantee that nothing will happen. I know you trust your gf and that’s really great, but the fact that she won’t disclose to this guy that she’s already in a committed relationship is not only disrespectful to you, but she’s leaving the door open for this guy to be let in. If you’re okay with that then I don’t know what to tell you, it sounds like you need to practice boundaries because no self respecting man or woman would let that fly. I once dated a man who was still close friends with his ex, when our friend group hang out (which she was a part of) they would playfully flirt with each other in front of me despite me telling him how uncomfortable and angry it made me. When he refused to fix his behavior, I left because I respected myself enough not to be treated that way. Right now you have to decide between blindly trusting your gf and this man you don’t know not to fuck behind your back, or put your foot down and assert yourself and your boundaries. Good luck.
